seoDescription: Indianapolis Public Schools starts Aug. 10, 2026 and ends May 27, 2027. See IPS breaks, asynchronous learning days, quarter dates, the official PDF, and an ICS download.
heroSummary: The first day of school for Indianapolis Public Schools students is Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break runs October 12–16, Thanksgiving Break is November 25–27, Winter Break runs December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is March 15–19. The IPS calendar lists 180 student days, including three asynchronous learning days.

calendarNotes: The IPS sheet is a combined student and staff calendar. Students begin August 10, after new-teacher induction, professional learning, and teacher work dates that start in July. September 8 and November 3 are staff professional-development days with no school. October 23 and March 26 are Student Progress Conference dates with Student Asynchronous Learning; February 16 is staff professional development with Student Asynchronous Learning. These three dates are instructional, not vacation days, and IPS counts one asynchronous day in semester 1 and two in semester 2. Fall Break runs October 12–16. The PDF prints Quarter 1 through Saturday, October 17 and Quarter 2 beginning Tuesday, October 20; it does not label Monday, October 19 as no school, so this page does not invent a closure. December 17 is the last student day of semester 1, December 18 is a no-school records day, and students return January 4. May 27 is the last student day, followed by a staff-only records day May 28. Memorial Day and Juneteenth observance dates appear after students finish.

customSections.label: What the IPS PDF Says About October 19
customSections.content: IPS does not mark Monday, October 19 as a no-school day, so we list it as the first day back after Fall Break. The quarter table still follows the dates printed in the district PDF: Quarter 1 ends October 17, and Quarter 2 begins October 20.

customSections.label: IPS Staff Calendar Before Students Start
customSections.content: The IPS calendar includes staff dates beginning in July. These dates come before students return on August 10 and are not student attendance days.

customSections.label: Which IPS Calendar Should My Family Use?
customSections.content: Families at district-managed IPS schools can use the district calendar for major dates. If your child attends an Innovation Network school, check the school's own calendar too. IPS also says Innovation Network schools make their own weather decisions.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Indianapolis Public Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for IPS students is Monday, August 10, 2026. New-teacher induction, staff work days, and professional learning begin in July.

calendarFaqs.q: When is IPS Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: IPS Fall Break runs Monday, October 12 through Friday, October 16, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is IPS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. The first student day of semester 2 is Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is IPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22, the first day of Quarter 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Are IPS asynchronous learning days school days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. October 23, February 16, and March 26 are asynchronous instructional days. IPS includes all three in its total of 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for IPS students in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. May 28 is a staff-only records day.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 16, 2026 against the official one-page IPS SY2026-27 English Student & Staff School Calendar and the IPS live calendar hub.
sourceReviewDetails: The image-based English PDF was checked for every dated legend item, quarter range, semester count, student total, staff total, and professional-learning list.
The student total is 180 days: semester 1 has 84 days including one asynchronous day, and semester 2 has 96 days including two asynchronous days. The staff total is 192 days.
The PDF prints Quarter 1 through October 17 and Quarter 2 beginning October 20. It does not mark October 19 as a no-school day, so this page lists October 19 as the first day back after Fall Break.

The official printable collection is labeled for District and Innovation Network calendars. This page uses the English IPS district Student & Staff School Calendar and does not claim that every network school follows it without exception.
